The court recognized the parents as distinct entities under state law, enabling them to seek higher restitution.

title: Why some hugs stay with us for years, according to study of 15,000 adults

By surveying over 15,000 adults, researchers found that feelings of comfort, support, and connection heavily influenced these memories. The analysis revealed interesting gender differences in remembering hugs, highlighting that individuals with high empathy recalled emotionally significant experiences more vividly. Additionally, personal attachment styles played a role in how people viewed their memorable hugging moments.

Purchasing the home in 1999 with help from her grandparents, Behny's extensive investments over 25 years were key. The Indiana Court of Appeals affirmed the lower court's ruling, noting Behny's substantial financial input against Curella's slight involvement, alongside an order for Curella to pay Behny for incurred losses.

title: California court overturns husband's $39,000 legal fee award filed too late

The couple had settled their competing restraining order requests in January 2024, but the husband sought legal fees 14 months later. On Wednesday, the appeals court overturned the award.

title: Kerala man sues IRCTC over Rs 1 short refund, wins Rs 3,100 compensation
description: After canceling an AC train ticket, a Kerala resident pursued legal recourse against IRCTC due to a one-rupee refund discrepancy. This issue highlighted the complexities surrounding refund amounts, leading the local consumer commission to find IRCTC liable for service deficiency and to demand compensation. With new cancellation policies being implemented by Indian Railways, travelers will face a new set of guidelines for managing ticket cancellations and refunds.

title: Man buys two paintings for $60, discovers they're worth $1.072m; sellers lose

After their authenticity was verified, Christie's auctioned these artworks for an astounding $1.072 million. The estate later attempted to reclaim the paintings, arguing a mutual mistake in valuation.

title: Uttarakhand chopper crash: Helicopter wreckage found - key points

Adverse weather conditions, including rain and snowfall, are affecting the search efforts. District administrations are on alert and monitoring road conditions and temple activities. Authorities have advised pilgrims to take precautions due to harsh weather conditions.

title: Meet Muhammed Riswan: 600m-view waterfall football trick earns Instagram award
description: Muhammed Riswan, the talented freestyle footballer from Kerala, skyrocketed to fame after a mesmerizing video featuring him performing tricks at Keralamkundu Waterfall went viral. The captivating clip not only earned him recognition from Guinness World Records but also led to his selection for Instagram's Rings Award, celebrating influential creators worldwide. His inspiring journey underscores the transformative power of social media in shaping careers and achieving personal milestones.

title: Why kids forget to brush their teeth after being told, according to psychology
description: Getting children ready in the morning can be challenging due to their developing memory skills, which are essential for task completion. Observations reveal that children often forget instructions as their attention shifts to other activities. Strategies such as providing visual reminders and making tasks more engaging can significantly help enhance their memory. Additionally, encouraging children to think ahead can promote greater responsibility in completing tasks.

title: Indiana court lifts hearing ban over unpaid $21,020 fees, upholds award
description: An Indiana appeals court has declared that a custody case cannot be stalled due to unpaid legal fees. Initially, the trial judge had suspended hearings until the mother paid her attorney $21,020, but this ruling was overturned. The ongoing custody matter, dating back to 2021, included disagreements over child support and custody dynamics. The father was awarded sole custody after the mother was found in indirect contempt.

German couple came to India for spirituality, now raise two kids in Mayapur
description: In 2015, a German couple embarked on a transformative journey to Mayapur, seeking spiritual growth and an enriching environment for their children. Their integration into the local community has allowed them to fully embrace the area's cultural practices. With their lives now shared through social media, they recently launched an online business.

title: $6.3bn gone, N Korea link: Inside crypto heist at world's largest exchange Binance
description: Hackers executed the largest theft in cryptocurrency history by stealing $6.36 billion from Binance wallets. The theft involved moving funds across 10 blockchains in a short time span. TRM Labs has linked the attack to TraderTraitor, an elite hacking unit from North Korea. Binance has committed to covering all losses through its Secure Asset Fund for Users.

title: Andhra man works to protect childhoods of 90,000 kids across 110 villages
description: Bethala Veera Swami established Pragathi Association for Rural Development India with a mission to improve educational access for rural children. The organization specializes in after-school tutoring, scholarships, and digital learning programs aimed at aiding at-risk students. By 2030, PARD India aspires to positively influence 20,000 children in 150 villages while promoting STEM initiatives in public schools and providing essential nutritional and vocational support for women to uplift community living standards.

title: Idaho court revives farm couple's 5.95-acre claim after decades of use
description: An Idaho couple who have farmed beside an old barbed-wire fence since 1979 are fighting the state over 5.95 acres of land they believed was theirs. Greg and Leah Sempel say they used the land for decades before Idaho acquired the neighbouring property in 1996. On October Tuesday, the state Supreme Court overturned an earlier ruling favouring Idaho, allowing the couple to continue their ownership claim.

title: Nevada mine site opens 3.5-acre park amid $257m arsenic and lead cleanup
description: Henderson, Nevada, is transforming the former Three Kids Mine into a thriving residential area, complete with new parks. The recently opened Greenbow Park offers recreation options such as pickleball courts and scenic walking trails. With plans for over 3,000 homes across 24 neighborhoods, the Aries master-planned community is set to revitalize the site, which underwent a $257 million cleanup from its industrial past into a lively suburban setting.

title: 'Jisko nahi fly karna woh nikal lo': Airline staff's reply to safety concerns
description: During a recent SpiceJet flight, passengers raised alarms about a loose window panel, leading to notable tension. Rather than addressing the safety concerns, staff reportedly suggested that those feeling uneasy should disembark. This incident, captured on video and shared widely on social media, highlights ongoing challenges in airline communication and safety assurance. At present, the airline has not released any clarification regarding the window issue.

title: Arshdeep Singh scripts history, becomes first Indian to 150 T20I wickets
description: Arshdeep Singh has made history as the first Indian bowler to reach 150 T20I wickets, accomplishing this remarkable feat during the fourth T20I match against New Zealand in Auckland. He achieved this milestone in just 103 matches across a span of over 1,577 days. Notably, in 2026, he also recorded the highest wickets in T20Is among players from Full Member nations, underscoring his vital role in Indian cricket's shortest format.

title: Fungus in Rs 230 butter pack: Panel orders Rs 2L payout, refers case to FSSAI
description: In Hyderabad, a woman discovered fungus in a packet of organic cooking butter she purchased. The commission determined that improper storage led to the contamination of the product sold by the retailer. Both the retailer and manufacturer were found guilty of unfair trade practices and deficiency in service. They were directed to refund the purchase price and pay compensation for the woman's mental agony.

title: 'Will be game over': Musk raises three 'concerns' against Democrats ahead of midterms

He pointed out potential transformative measures like granting statehood to Washington DC and Puerto Rico, legalizing undocumented immigrants, and enlarging the Supreme Court. Musk contends these could cement a long-term one-party system in America.

Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.

This victory came as the BJP-led NDA claimed 16 out of a total of 28 seats. Independent candidate Nitesh Karale played a pivotal role in shaping the electoral outcome.
